Resolves #19931

Wait for both the date and the bound weekday formatter before building a day view. Make the formatter reactive so the grid renders when the binding arrives and follows later format changes. Add regressions for the real selector and both input arrival orders.

Evidence: L3 (rendered example in real Chromium, plus exact-baseline unit regressions) -> L3 required (AC-1 browser load/render and AC-2 failing/passing regression). No residual ACs.

## AC Evidence

| Acceptance criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | Outside CI: the actual example loads at desktop 1365x900 and mobile 390x844, renders its date selector, and records zero page/console errors, warnings, failed requests, or framework overlays. Switching weekday names long -> short updates the rendered headings. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered spec: `test/playwright/unit/date/SelectorContainer.spec.mjs`. The same three tests fail against unchanged production at `c6b71bf39b8ee46cfa51a645b2fe5b3b0f3656d6` and pass with the fix. Local `npm run test-unit -- --workers=4 --reporter=list`: 5345 passed, 3 skipped, zero failures. |

## Deltas from ticket

The grid also waits for `currentDate`: real selector construction in the unit environment exposes a null `getDate` before the reported null `format`. Both come from building before the inputs exist. Scope stays within the day-view component and one unit spec.

Change class: restoration. `agent-preflight` is not hosted in this Engine checkout; the applicable repository guards, normal hooks, PR-body guard, and substrate-size baseline run separately.

## Test Evidence

- With browser request interception serving the exact baseline `DayViewComponent.mjs`, the example renders nothing and raises the reported null `format` error. The interception receipt confirms one baseline-module request. Without interception, the modified module renders the calendar and supports weekday-format changes.
- The unchanged baseline worktree runs the identical new spec: one case reproduces null `format`, and two reproduce null `getDate`. Neither missing imports nor browser startup errors are counted as product regressions.
- Exploratory month-radio redraw and selected-cell styling checks did not meet their expectations. Those broader interactions are outside this load/render ticket and are not claimed as passing. No calendar-weekview, selection, month-navigation, dependency, or workflow repair is included.
- Browser validation uses headless Chromium 156.0.8078.4 against the development server. Firefox, Safari, release packaging, and the complete browser component/E2E tiers were not run.
